svg.title: White Noise Mean
svg.desc: Plot: white noise mean versus time over 0 to 300 seconds, y axis labeled "Radians (degrees)." A flat line marks the expected noise mean of zero. The measured mean dips to about minus 0.1 in the first few seconds, rises to about 0.4 by 45 seconds, then wanders between roughly 0.3 and 0.6 until about 240 seconds, ending near 0.28. It never settles back to zero, showing a persistent, drifting error.
